name: The Monogrammed Sash
summary: In Stranglethorn Vale, a lost sash bears initials that may lead to its owner. Finding the seafarer who lost it leads on to The Captain's Cutlass.

sections.title: A Marked Garment
sections.body: You find a fine sash with the initials HS embroidered along its hem. Those two letters are the only clue to who lost it.

sections.title: The Smotts Connection
sections.body: Returning the sash to Captain Hecklebury Smotts confirms it is his. Its recovery brings news that the sea giant Mok'rash has been slain, news to the captain. The brute had helped destroy his vessels and crew more than once, and the news brings him relief.

faq.q: What letters are stitched into the sash?
faq.answer: The sash's hem bears the embroidered initials HS.

aliases: what quest comes after monogrammed sash
faq.answer: After you return the sash to its owner, the next step leads to The Captain's Cutlass.
